subject: Clarify invoice trigger, PO placement, and tax/residency for Order Form
messages:
From: Emily Reid <emily.reid@starlightanalytics.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@starlightanalytics.com, legal@starlightanalytics.com
Date: Sun, 28 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Invoice cadence and tax/residency questions for Redwood order form

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks again for the call this morning. We reviewed the Order Form draft and have three items Procurement + Legal need clarified before we can issue a PO: 

1) Invoice trigger: our accounting wants to know whether invoices will be raised on a calendar cadence (monthly) or on hit of committed usage milestones (e.g., each tranche). We need this documented in the Order Form.

2) PO placement: please confirm whether Redwood requires the PO number to appear on Line 1 of invoices, or if it can be in the invoice footer. Our AP system rejects invoices without the PO in the Invoice Number field.

3) Tax / withholding: Because we are an EU entity, are we expected to reverse-charge VAT, or will Redwood invoice inclusive of UK/EU VAT? Legal has asked for a statement on tax residency and whether Redwood provides VAT registration evidence.

I've attached our suggested redlines (high level) and a sample invoice for format. Can you route to the right folks and let me know by EOD tomorrow?

Appreciate it,
Emily
Procurement Lead — Starlight Analytics

--- attachment: starlight_orderform_redline_v2.pdf (application/pdf)
--- attachment: invoice_sample_with_PO.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Reid <emily.reid@starlightanalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 28 Nov 2027 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Invoice cadence and tax/residency questions for Redwood order form

Emily —

Thanks for the clear list. Quick responses below and then I pulled Ben and Lauren into thread for billing/finance sequencing: 

1) Invoice trigger: We typically invoice monthly for hosted usage. For committed tranches we can issue milestone invoices at the start of each tranche to match your PO schedule. Suggest we include a clause: "Invoices will be issued monthly unless otherwise agreed for committed tranche billing; where committed tranche billing is selected, Redwood will issue invoice(s) at the start of the tranche."

2) PO placement: We can include PO on Line 1 of the invoice. Our standard template includes a PO field; I'll attach a sample rendered with PO in the invoice number field.

3) Tax/residency: Redwood is registered for VAT in the UK and EU (we will provide registration evidence). For EU-to-EU B2B transactions with valid VAT IDs, customers are typically reverse-charged. Where customers do not provide a VAT ID, Redwood will apply VAT by default. We'll add language requiring the customer to provide valid tax residency details and a VAT ID to enable reverse-charge treatment.

Next steps I propose: Ben to confirm the milestone invoice wording and whether early tranche invoices affect credits; Lauren to confirm whether we can pass "net45" for larger deals or whether finance needs net30. If you can push your PO timeframe (when they can issue) that helps us line up invoice dates.

Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

--- attachment: redwood_invoice_sample_with_PO.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Emily Reid <emily.reid@starlightanalytics.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 28 Nov 2027 12:34:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Invoice cadence and tax/residency questions for Redwood order form

Emily / Kim —

Agree with Kim's proposals. A couple of operational notes from Finance: 
- If we invoice at the start of each tranche we treat that as an advance invoice (non-refundable credit). We want the Order Form to clarify credit application on cancellation. 
- We can accept PO on Line 1 as requested. Send us a sample PO format if Starlight has a specific required field mapping.
- Net terms: for this deal we can offer Net45 if Starlight signs the Order Form with a 12-month minimum commit and provides a signed PO within 10 business days of signature. Otherwise standard Net30 applies.

I'll put a short paragraph for the Order Form redline and share it by EOD.

Ben Carter
Director, Revenue Operations

From: Emily Reid <emily.reid@starlightanalytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: legal@starlightanalytics.com
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 08:17:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Invoice cadence and tax/residency questions for Redwood order form

Thanks Ben — that Net45 tied to the 12-month minimum seems reasonable, and we can commit to a PO within 10 business days once our procurement sign-off completes. Legal did flag one more item: they want a short sentence confirming that VAT residency evidence (VAT registration certificate) can be supplied post-execution and that invoices will be adjusted if a valid VAT ID is later provided (i.e., issue credit on previously charged VAT). Is Redwood comfortable making that operational commitment?

Also, legal suggested adding a line that the PO number must be quoted on the invoice and that failure to include it may delay payment processing (so that internal AP handles rejects).

Emily

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Reid <emily.reid@starlightanalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 16:41:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Invoice cadence and tax/residency questions for Redwood order form

Emily —

Yes, we can commit to: (a) accepting VAT residency evidence post-signature and issuing an adjusting credit if a valid VAT ID is supplied within 90 days of the invoice date; and (b) including a clause that a missing PO may delay payment processing but will not invalidate the invoice. I'll incorporate both items into the Order Form redline and send back a clean copy + a tracked redline.

Action items: 
- Kim: update Order Form language + attach updated PDF (by Tue EOD PT)
- Ben: include the Net45 callout tied to 12-month minimum commit and PO timeframe in the redline
- Emily: confirm expected date for PO issuance (approx is fine) and share any PO template mapping fields (if required)

If everyone is aligned, we'll push the revised Order Form and DocuSign link for signature.

Thanks —
Kimberly
